scoring.description: Teams track progress on a five-rung score comb, erasing one rung for each point earned by winning a hand, winning all nine tricks, or scoring from legal risks and smacks with the King of hearts.
scoring.winCondition: The first partnership to erase all five rungs on their side of the score comb wins the game; the number of remaining rungs on the losing side shows the margin of victory.
